scope: New adapter production source, opt-in conformance harness and parent-authored measurement example. Reviewer-authored tests/canonical.rs, tests/common/mod.rs and tests/transfer.rs were excluded from independent approval.

resolved_findings.title: Persist recorded verification before deleting the session store
resolved_findings.issue: Session cleanup preceded session completion output and the only file sync occurred after the entire campaign, allowing an evidence write/sync failure after store deletion.
resolved_findings.resolution: DurableWrite for File invokes sync_all. run_session persists all operation and exact stopped-store verification rows before dropping/removing the store, then writes and persists session_complete. The campaign root is removed before the global complete marker.
resolved_findings.retained_red: qualification/evidence-sync-red.txt and evidence-sync-red.exit record the injected sync failure test failing because the prior implementation returned success; exit 101
resolved_findings.retained_green: qualification/final-tests.txt and final-tests.exit record failed_evidence_sync_retains_verified_store and the mixed-session recording test passing; exit 0
resolved_findings.independent_check: The reviewer read the fix and both retained execution logs without rerunning commands. Vec persistence is implemented only inside the test module; the executable uses File.sync_all.

review_observations: The 64 KiB application frame limit and 256 KiB encoded envelope/queue cap remain separate. Exact directional message kinds, accepted content type and configured signer/public-key consistency are enforced.

The send and open paths use pinned canonical MVM envelope cryptography and transport authorization. Receive-only configuration needs no remote signing secret. A canonical open plus bounded Frame decoding precedes authority installation.

Policy generations invalidate old leases and VerifiedFrames. The README correctly excludes an atomic concurrent revocation/publication transaction and requires current policy/time refresh before live deployment.

Replay capacity fails closed without evicting prior identities. Successful-send counters and attempted inbound-byte counters have distinct semantics; the example requires successful send/open totals to agree and counts each sent envelope only once.
The conformance harness is feature-gated, uses ephemeral keys, checks application transfer/sequence/reply kinds and reopens the existing store while retaining process-local crypto/replay state.

The registered measurement alternates arm order, preserves prepared state, records setup and the equal raw seed separately, charges warm schema publication, and compares every original byte after reopening. The 600-byte value is only an HTTP body model; actual canonical-envelope bytes and combined sequential host CPU/elapsed time are separately recorded.
The fixed example persists verified evidence before removing only directories it freshly created. A pre-cleanup evidence sync error returns with the verified cache still present.
explicit_limits: No live guest/vsock, network-send time, WAN performance, FIPS/CUI qualification or production security approval is established by this review.
The fixture uses fixed time and epochs. Replay and accepted-message state are not durable across a process crash.
Upstream verified reply handles, mailbox admission/rate enforcement, key provisioning and the concurrent revocation/publication boundary remain integration work.
The unchanged selector's HTTP body cost model is not proven optimal for canonical MVM envelope bytes.
No build, test or measurement was run by the reviewer; root-owned retained logs were inspected.
